title: Add Gray square-QAM presets
description:
Provide built-in normalized Gray-coded presets for BPSK, QPSK, 16-QAM, 64-QAM, and 256-QAM through the shared modem surface.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Public preset constructors exist for the supported Gray-coded square-QAM family.
- [ ] Presets use the same high-level modem API as custom constellations.
- [ ] Preset definitions are normalized consistently so downstream demappers can rely on them.

## Notes

This task is the first leaf task under the optimized Gray square-QAM story.
